proposals.evidence: DEDR 5352 full article (p. 484) gives 5352 Ta. vāy mouth, beak of birds, mouth as of cup, bag, ulcer, etc., mouthful, lip, edge, rim, edge as of a knife, word, speech, hole, orifice. Ma. vāy, vā mouth, opening, juncture, edge of Bhat bāyi “mouth” matches Lindgren Koraga bāyi “mouth” in form and sense; this cross-source match is a candidate lead, with the full DEDR article defining the family. Both source identities and dialect tags are preserved.
